Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. An employee who is not FLSA-eligible has no qualified overtime compensation (Notice 2025-69, pp. 22-25; i1040gi p. 106), so the project enters $0 for this employer and the method question does not arise; the model also refused the method. The employer's column (b) and line 14a agree.
